The fourth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series was directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]] and produced by [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ BLEACH =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-04-07}}</ref> Like the rest of the series, the season follows the adventures of [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] and company, but instead of adapting content from [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' manga series, it features an original, self-contained [[Filler (media)|filler]] story arc.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/review/bleach-season-4-box-set-2/the-bount |title=Bleach Season 4 Box Set 2: The Bount|date=2010-09-07|author=Martin, Theron|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref> The twenty-eight episodes form the {{nihongo|'''Bount arc'''|バウント篇|Baunto Hen}}, which focuses on the introduction of the Bount, a race of vampiric beings that consume human souls to extend their lives, and their conflicts with Ichigo and his allies.

The season aired from January to August 2006 on [[TV Tokyo]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/archive_53-.html |title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (53-65) |publisher=[[TV Tokyo]] |language=ja |access-date=2008-10-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080728004926/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/archive_53-.html |archive-date=2008-07-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes07/|title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (79-91)|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=2008-10-14|archive-date=2012-10-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121003053756/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes07/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The English adaptation of the season aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] in the United States from May to December 2008.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2008-01-28/adult-swim-to-run-52-more-episodes-of-bleach|title=Adult Swim to Run 52 More Episodes of Bleach|website=[[Anime News Network]]|date=2008-01-28|access-date=2009-04-12}}</ref><ref name="air"/> Seven DVD compilations, each containing four episodes of the season, were released by [[Aniplex]] between May 24 to December 20, 2006.<ref name="StudioPierrotDVD1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/goods/2006/05/bleach_1_4.html|title=BLEACH バウント篇1|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080113124230/http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/goods/2006/05/bleach_1_4.html|archive-date=January 13, 2008}}</ref><ref name="AmazonJPDVD7">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000J3FCPG|title=BLEACH バウント篇 7|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-25}}</ref> Viz Media released the season on seventeen DVDs from May 12 to November 17, 2009. Each of them contain four episodes in both English and Japanese languages.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B001RUALAG/|title=Bleach, Vol. 16|website=Amazon |access-date=2009-06-07}}</ref><ref name="VizDVD22">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8395 |title=Bleach, Vol. 22 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2009-07-11 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090723010811/http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8395 |archive-date=2009-07-23 }}</ref> Two DVD box sets collecting the entire season were released on November 3, 2009, and February 16, 2010.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B002FG9N64/ |title=Bleach Uncut Box Set: Season 4, Part 1 - The Bount|website=Amazon |access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B002UTNJI4/ |title=Bleach Uncut Box Set: Season 4, Part 2 - The Bount|website=Amazon |access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref> [[Manga Entertainment]] released the season in three DVDs for the United Kingdom from October 26, 2009, to June 7, 2010,<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B001U3EONU/|title=Bleach - Series 4 Part 1|website=Amazon UK |access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0037B2WSM/ |title=Bleach - Series 4 Part 3|website=Amazon UK |access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref> while a box set was released on August 9, 2010.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B003TG5P84/ |title=Bleach Series 4 Complete Box Set|website=Amazon UK |access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref>

The episodes use five pieces of theme music: two opening themes and three ending themes. The opening theme for the first eleven episodes is {{nihongo|"[[Ichirin no Hana]]"|一輪の花|Ichirin no Hana}} by [[High and Mighty Color]];<ref name="music1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060125005753/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2006-01-25|language=ja}}</ref> the rest of the episodes use "Tonight, Tonight, Tonight" by [[Beat Crusaders]].<ref name="music2">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060423052557/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2006-04-23|language=ja}}</ref> The first ending theme is {{nihongo|"My Pace"|マイペース|Mai Pēsu}} by [[SunSet Swish]],<ref name="music1" /> switching at episode 75 to "Hanabi" by [[Ikimonogakari]]<ref name="music2" /> and switching at episode 87 to "Movin!!" by Takacha.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060821195513/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2006-08-21|language=ja}}</ref>

| ShortSummary    = After returning from the Soul Society, [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] resumes his everyday life as a high school student in Karakura Town. [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#lieutenant|Lieutenant]] [[Renji Abarai]] arrives in Karakura, however, and Ichigo claims that Renji is his cousin to the surrounding onlookers. Later that night, [[Orihime Inoue]] has a dream about her brother Sora, and is drawn into a large gate while three mysterious people observe.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

| ShortSummary    = After Orihime disappears, Ichigo, Renji, [[Uryū Ishida]] and [[Yasutora Sado|Yasutora "Chad" Sado]] try to find her. A mysterious girl contacts Renji on his cellphone, and reveals that Orihime will return to her house at eight o'clock. They find Orihime at that time, but she is an imposter. Chad is then taken by the three figures.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 66
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = Breakthrough! The Trap Hidden in the Labyrinth
| TranslitTitle   = Toppa seyo! Meikyū ni Hisomu Wana
| NativeTitle     = 突破せよ！迷宮に潜む罠
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = [[Shigeru Ueda]]
| DirectedBy      = Shigeru Ueda
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|1|31}}
| AltDate         = June 1, 2008
| ShortSummary    = After the loss of Chad, the caller instructs Ichigo, Renji and Uryū to appear at the local museum for a continuation of her game. Once there, the museum turns into a looping maze with illusions and traps. Along the way, the group starts to splinter apart due to their irritation and desire to find their own way in the maze. As Ichigo and Renji start to walk off, Uryū notices a limitation of the illusion and plots a way out. When they escape the maze, it becomes apparent that the three mysterious people are [[List of Bleach characters#Modified souls|modified souls]]. Following this revelation, they make their escape, leaving Orihime and Chad behind.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 67
| EpisodeNumber2  = 4
| Title           = Death Game! The Missing Classmate
| TranslitTitle   = Shi no Gēmu! Kieru Kurasumeito
| NativeTitle     = 死のゲーム！消えるクラスメイト
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = [[Motosuke Takahashi]]
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = [[Rika Nakase]]
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|2|7}}
| AltDate         = June 8, 2008
| ShortSummary    = After leaving the museum, the group is confronted by the modified souls, who tell them that one of their core group has been replaced by an imposter, and they must find out who that is before noon, or everyone in their school will be killed. While out in the hall at Ichigo's school, he becomes suspicious of Renji thinking that he is the imposter. He tells him to "take it off". Ichigo means Renji's ''gigai'' but he does not specify it. The class goes out to see what the commotion is about and find Ichigo and Renji in a suggestive position. As the group attempts to find the imposter, [[List of Bleach characters#Tatsuki Arisawa|Tatsuki Arisawa]], one of Ichigo's classmates, disappears. At the last minute, it is decided that the imposter was posing as Chad, but the modified souls had already kidnapped the students.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 68
| EpisodeNumber2  = 5
| Title           = True Identity of the Devil, the Secret which Is Revealed
| TranslitTitle   = Akuma no Shōtai, Akasareta Himitsu
| NativeTitle     = 悪魔の正体、明かされた秘密
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Noriyuki Abe
| DirectedBy      = Akira Shimizu
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|2|14}}{{efn|name=A|Episodes 68 and 69 originally aired together as a one-hour special.}}
| AltDate         = June 15, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and the others begin the final game against the modified souls. The modified souls conjure a massive gate that consumes the group. After putting Chad into a giant hourglass, the modified soul [[List of Bleach characters#Lirin|Lirin]] tells Ichigo and the others that they have five minutes to defeat the modified souls and save Chad. Ichigo manages to break the hourglass and discovers that [[Kisuke Urahara]] had planned this as a group training exercise, as well as to tell the group that Uryū no longer has his [[List of Bleach characters#Quincy|Quincy]] powers. Meanwhile, Soul Reapers [[Yoruichi Shihōin]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Suì-Fēng|Suì-Fēng]] have been investigating the Bounts, a group of humans that consume souls for sustenance. Finding the remains of a soul, they rush away to the site of another attack, where Yoruichi stops a woman from consuming another soul.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|name=penname|Credited under the pen name {{nihongo|"Kumi Hitokuchi"|一口 久美|Hitokuchi Kumi}}.}}
| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|2|14}}{{efn|name=A}}
| AltDate         = June 22, 2008
| ShortSummary    = At Urahara's shop, Kisuke discusses about the Bounts with Ichigo and his friends, and orders the modified souls, Lirin, [[List of Bleach characters#Noba|Noba]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Kurōdo|Kurōdo]], to accompany them. The group subsequently locates a pair of Bounts, [[List of Bleach characters#Yoshino Sōma|Yoshino Sōma]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Ryō Utagawa|Ryō Udagawa]]. As Udagawa retreats, Ichigo begins to battle Yoshino, who summons her "doll" Goethe, a [[Familiar spirit|Familiar]] unique to each of the Bounts.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 70
| EpisodeNumber2  = 7
| Title           = Rukia's Return! Revival of the Substitute Team!
| TranslitTitle   = Rukia no Kikan! Daikō Chīmu Fukkatsu
| NativeTitle     = ルキアの帰還！代行チーム復活
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = [[Michiko Yokote]]

| AltDate         = June 29, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Goethe overwhelms Ichigo with his fire attacks, and Ichigo is saved by [[Rukia Kuchiki]]. Goethe continues to attack, but is restrained by Udagawa, who takes Yoshino and Goethe away from the battle. After the battle, Ichigo and his friends celebrate Rukia's return, and discuss the Bounts' threat in Ichigo's house. The following day, Udagawa begins to consume the souls of the humans he encounters, and Ichigo and his friends begin to fight him. Elsewhere, Yoshino escapes from the Bounts' headquarters, and is watched by the leader of the Bounts, [[List of Bleach characters#Jin Kariya|Jin Kariya]].
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

| ShortSummary    = Udagawa manages to capture Uryū, but Yoshino takes Uryū away from him. Udagawa uses his doll to summon a wave of snakes, but retreats after [[List of Bleach characters#Ururu Tsumugiya|Ururu Tsumugiya]] begins attacking him with her bazooka. In the Soul Society, Soul Reaper captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shunsui Kyōraku|Shunsui Kyōraku]] asks twelfth division captain [[Mayuri Kurotsuchi]] about the Bounts. However, Mayuri refuses to show him the data and later discovers that it has been erased. Uryū awakens in an apartment, where Yoshino tells him that Kariya seeks a Quincy in order to open a gateway to the "world of the dead".
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 72
| EpisodeNumber2  = 9
| Title           = Water Attack! Escape from the Shutdown Hospital
| TranslitTitle   = Mizu no Kōgeki! Tozasareta Byōin kara no Dasshutsu

| AltDate         = July 13, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and the others receive a message from Uryū and find him at the hospital. The hospital room then floods with water, which the group realizes is the dolls of unidentified Bount members. The dolls attempt to drown Uryū, but Uryū is rescued when Ichigo cuts the water dolls. The group attempts to flee and they encounter the two Bount members, [[List of Bleach characters#Hō|Hō]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Ban|Ban]]. As the rest of the group retreats with Uryū, Ichigo and Renji fight Hō and Ban.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 73
| EpisodeNumber2  = 10
| Title           = Gathering Bounts! The Man Who Makes His Move
| TranslitTitle   = Baunto Shūketsu! Ugokidasu Otoko
| NativeTitle     = バウント集結！動き出す男
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|3|28}}{{efn|name=B|Episodes 73 and 74 originally aired together as a one-hour special.}}
| AltDate         = July 20, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and Renji's fight with Hō and Ban takes them outside the hospital. Hō and Ban transform their dolls into massive pillars of water that swallow up Ichigo, Renji and Rukia as Chad and Orihime try to get Uryū to safety. Giving up on drowning Ichigo and the others, the twins decide to go after Uryū. Chad starts to fight the twins and separates them, causing their dolls to collapse. In response, Hō and Ban force Ichigo and company to drink their dolls, allowing the twins to rip their bodies apart from the inside. [[List of Bleach characters#Ganju Shiba|Ganju Shiba]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Hanatarō Yamada|Hanatarō Yamada]] arrive, and Ganju uses his fireworks to destroy the dolls, killing Hō and Ban. As the group surveys the aftermath, however, they realize that Uryū is missing.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist

| EpisodeNumber2  = 11
| Title           = Memories of an Eternally Living Clan
| TranslitTitle   = Eien o Ikiru Ichizoku no Kioku

| AltDate         = July 26, 2008
| ShortSummary    = As Uryū wanders aimlessly away from his friends, he encounters Yoshino again, who tells him how the Bount's longevity leads to the deterioration of their mental state. Meanwhile, Kariya informs the Bounts that he has found a Quincy, and that he will lead them into a new shining era. In the Soul Society, eleventh division captain [[Kenpachi Zaraki]] learns that [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Maki Ichinose|Maki Ichinose]], a former member of his division he believed to be dead, is alive. Ichinose, unknown to Kenpachi, has joined Kariya's Bounts.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 75
| EpisodeNumber2  = 12
| Title           = Earth-Shattering Event at 11th Squad! The Shinigami Who Rises Again
| TranslitTitle   = Jūichibantai Gekishin! Yomigaetta Shinigami
| NativeTitle     = 十一番隊激震！よみがえった死神
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Takeshi Shirai
| WrittenBy       = Michiko Yokote
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|4|4}}{{efn|name=C|Episodes 75 and 76 originally aired together as a one-hour special.}}
| AltDate         = August 2, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Yoshino and Uryū are attacked by the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Gō Koga|Gō Koga]], who summons his doll, Dalk, a collection of metal balls that manifests as a humanoid spider creature. Following a short battle, Koga captures both of them, and takes them to Kariya's mansion. Using the modified souls' sensing abilities, Ichigo is able to track the Bounts, and travels to their location. In the Soul Society, Mayuri has called a meeting of all the Soul Reaper captains, and informs them that there is a traitor in their midst that erased items from his database. Kenpachi begins to suspect that Ichinose is the culprit. Meanwhile, Kariya attempts to gain Uryū's loyalty by promising a better world for Bounts and Quincy, but Uryū is suspicious of Kariya's intentions.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

Ichinose leaves to protect Kariya when he notices that Udagawa has stopped fighting Ichigo and attempted to betray Kariya. Ichinose kills Udagawa and begins to fight with Ichigo.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

As a member of the eleventh division, he was horrified when Kenpachi slew the previous captain, and attempted to avenge his captain by killing Kenpachi, who easily defeats Ichinose. | OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|5|2}}
| AltDate         = August 31, 2008
| ShortSummary    = In the Soul Society, Mayuri explains the Bounts' history to the other captains. In the past, the Quincy and the Bounts had a battle that the Bounts lost. Following this incident, the Bounts began to consume living souls to increase their power. As such, Mayuri concludes that the number of living souls attacked will escalate as the Bounts become more active. In Karakura Town, Ichigo is depressed by his defeat by Kariya. Ganju and Renji both fight Ichigo, and after Renji lectures him, Ichigo realizes how unfocused he has become.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}

| AltDate         = September 7, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and Renji spend the entire night training under Urahara's shop. Elsewhere, Yoshino fuses with Goethe in order to increase her strength. She attempts to kill Kariya, and he easily defeats her. Following her death, he uses her body to create the ''bitto'', insects able to consume souls.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 80
| EpisodeNumber2  = 17
| Title           = Assault from a Formidable Enemy! A Tiny Final Line of Defense?!
| TranslitTitle   = Kyōteki no Kyūshū! Chiisana Saishū Bōei Sen!?

| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|5|16}}
| AltDate         = September 13, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Due to the lack of Bount sightings, Urahara decides that he and Renji should go and investigate the Bounts' mansion, and sends Ichigo home with the modified souls to devise countermeasures. Lirin and Kurōdo wear special suits to trick Ichigo into thinking they are Bounts as to get back at him but things go bad when Rukia falls for the trick and continuously attacks them across town. Lirin, Kurōdo, and Noba present a variety of ideas, but at the day's end, none of them are able to produce an actual anti-Bount device.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 81
| EpisodeNumber2  = 18
| Title           = Hitsugaya Moves! The Attacked City
| TranslitTitle   = Hitsugaya Ugoku! Osowareta Machi
| NativeTitle     = 日番谷動く！襲われた街
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| DirectedBy      = Eitarō Ano
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|5|23}}
| AltDate         = September 20, 2008
| ShortSummary    = In Karakura Town, humans are being attacked by the ''bitto'', which suck out their souls and reduce their bodies into dust. They then return to the Bounts and provide them with purified souls to drink in order to increase their power. Members of Suì-Fēng's second division attack the ''bitto'', but they cannot damage them. Tenth division [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#captain|captain]] [[Tōshirō Hitsugaya]] orders more Soul Reapers to enter the human world, noting that they cannot rely on Ichigo alone. Meanwhile, Renji defends a human boy against a ''bitto'' assault.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 82
| EpisodeNumber2  = 19
| Title           = Ichigo vs. Dalk! Appearance of the Faded Darkness
| TranslitTitle   = Ichigo VS Daruku! Shirakigami no Shutsugen
| NativeTitle     = 一護VSダルク！白き闇の出現
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|name=penname}}
| WrittenBy       = Michiko Yokote
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|5|30}}
| AltDate         = October 4, 2008
| ShortSummary    = After the Bounts consume the power of the ''bitto'', Kariya tells the Bounts to test their new powers while he retires to his room. The Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Yoshi|Yoshi]] attacks Rukia, Orihime and Kurōdo while they are on their way to help Renji. Meanwhile, Ichigo is attacked by Koga and his doll Dalk, which ensnares Ichigo in a metal net, and Ichigo's [[List of Bleach characters#Hollow Ichigo|inner hollow]] takes over his body, allowing him to defeat the doll easily. However before dealing the final blow, Ichigo manages to regain control of his body, and subsequently collapses from exhaustion.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist

| EpisodeNumber2  = 20

| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| AltDate         = October 11, 2008
| ShortSummary    = As Koga tells Dalk to finish Ichigo off, he is reminded of [[List of Bleach characters#Cain|Cain]], a young Bount he once mentored. In a flashback, Koga remembers when he first met Cain, and taught him how to summon his doll and live with another Bount. However, the doll Cain created was too powerful for him to control and destroyed him, an incident Koga continues to regret.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 84
| EpisodeNumber2  = 21
| Title           = Dissension in the Substitute Team? Rukia's Betrayal
| TranslitTitle   = Daikō Chīmu Bunretsu? Uragitta Rukia
| NativeTitle     = 代行チーム分裂？裏切ったルキア
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = [[Tetsuya Endo (director)|Tetsuya Endō]]
| DirectedBy      = Takeshi Shirai
| WrittenBy       = Rika Nakase
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|6|13}}{{efn|name=D|Episodes 84 and 85 originally aired together as a one-hour special due to the [[2006 World Cup]].}}
| AltDate         = October 18, 2008
| ShortSummary    = As Dalk prepares to deal the final blow to Ichigo, third division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Izuru Kira|Izuru Kira]] arrives and fights with Dalk. Using the ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'' of his ''zanpakutō'', Kira attacks Dalk, increasing her weight with every strike. Eventually, Dalk is rendered unable to move, and Kira begins to battle Koga. Meanwhile, Yoshi is overpowering Orihime and Rukia, but her lack of cooperation with her doll causes her to miss a fatal attack to Rukia. The Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Mabashi|Mabashi]] arrives, and uses his doll Ritz to enter Rukia's soul and take over her body.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 85
| EpisodeNumber2  = 22
| Title           = Deadly Battle of Tears! Rukia vs. Orihime
| TranslitTitle   = Namida no Shitō! Rukia VS Orihime
| NativeTitle     = 涙の死闘！ルキアVS織姫
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|6|13}}{{efn|name=D}}
| AltDate         = October 25, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Using Ritz to control Rukia, Mabashi forces Rukia to fight Orihime, who is unwilling to fight against Rukia, as she had traveled with Ichigo to the Soul Society for the purpose of saving her. Ninth division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shūhei Hisagi|Shūhei Hisagi]] arrives and after learning of the situation from Orihime, intends to kill Rukia. However, Orihime manages to separate Ritz from Rukia with her abilities, and Hisagi defeats Ritz. Before Hisagi can attack Mabashi, Ichinose arrives and retreats with Mabashi.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 86
| EpisodeNumber2  = 23
| Title           = Rangiku Dances! Slice the Invisible Enemy!
| TranslitTitle   = Rangiku Mau! Mienai Teki o Kire!
| NativeTitle     = 乱菊舞う！見えない敵を斬れ
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|6|20}}
| AltDate         = November 1, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Tenth division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Rangiku Matsumoto|Rangiku Matsumoto]] encounters Chad, Ururu and Noba battling with the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Sawatari|Sawatari]], who summons his doll, Baura, a giant rocklike fish that is able to travel through solid surfaces by phasing into a different dimension. Due to this ability, Chad and Rangiku find it difficult to attack Baura, and Baura manages to swallow Ururu. Rangiku uses herself as bait to lure Baura out of the ground, and he is attacked by Chad, who sends him into Noba. Noba uses his powers to send Sawatari and Baura to another dimension, but the pair manage to escape, injuring Noba.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 87
| EpisodeNumber2  = 24
| Title           = Byakuya is summoned! The Gotei 13 start to move!
| TranslitTitle   = Byakuya Shōshū! Ugokidasu Gotei Jūsantai
| NativeTitle     = 白哉召集！動き出す護廷十三隊
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Kazunori Mizuno
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|name=penname}}
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo<hr>Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|7|4}}
| AltDate         = November 9, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Despite his injuries, Noba teleports Rangiku and Chad to a distant location to plan an attack on Sawatari. By linking Noba's ability to sense the Bount with her ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#kidō|kidō]]'' spell, Rangiku locates Sawatari and Chad punches Baura, forcing him to release Ururu. In the Soul Society, Mayuri has found the lost data on the Bounts and instructs his lieutenant, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Nemu Kurotsuchi|Nemu Kurotsuchi]], to give an item to Uryū. Elsewhere in the Soul Society, an intruder manages to enter the Seireitei, the Soul Reaper fortress. Afterwards, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]], the captain of the first division and leader of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads, summons sixth division captain [[Byakuya Kuchiki]].
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 88
| EpisodeNumber2  = 25
| Title           = Annihilation of the Lieutenants!? Trap in the Underground Cave
| TranslitTitle   = Fukutaichō Zenmetsu!? Chika Dōkutsu no Wana
| NativeTitle     = 副隊長全滅!?地下洞窟の罠
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun Takada
| DirectedBy      = Eitarō Ano
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|7|11}}
| AltDate         = November 16, 2008
| ShortSummary    = After defeating the Bounts in their respective battles, Ichigo and his friends regroup at Urahara's shop while the Soul Reapers that came to the human world head towards the Bounts' hideout. The Soul Reapers are accosted by the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Ugaki|Ugaki]], who uses his doll Gesell to separate the Soul Reapers and begins to defeat them individually with Gesell. In the Soul Society, Yamamoto informs Byakuya that Mayuri is suspected of treason and requests that Byakuya give him any records the Kuchiki clan has of the Bounts.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 89
| EpisodeNumber2  = 26
| Title           = Rematch?! Ishida vs. Nemu
| TranslitTitle   = Saisen!? Ishida VS Nemu
| NativeTitle     = 再戦!?石田VSネム
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| DirectedBy      = Takeshi Shirai
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|7|18}}
| AltDate         = November 23, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and Renji arrive at the mouth of the cave and are quickly surrounded by Gesell, which takes the form of a large group of small, one-eyed flying creatures. They meet Rangiku, who tells them to destroy anything that can cast a shadow, and they manage to defeat the creatures. However, they forget that their own bodies can also create shadows, which is what Ugaki uses to bring forth two sword arms. Luckily for them, Hisagi and Kira come to help. Meanwhile, Uryū is visited by Nemu, who proceeds to attack Uryū to confirm that he has lost his powers. Nemu then gives Uryū a Quincy battle accessory to allow him to use his powers.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 90
| EpisodeNumber2  = 27
| Title           = Renji Abarai, Bankai of the Soul!
| TranslitTitle   = Abarai Renji, Tamashii no Bankai!
| NativeTitle     = 阿散井恋次、魂の卍解！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Motosuke Takahashi
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|7|25}}
| AltDate         = November 30, 2008
| ShortSummary    = As Ichigo and Renji travel deeper into the cave, they find Yumichika. Ugaki summons the true form of Gesell, a large black, humanoid creature. Gesell throws Yumichika's body at Ichigo and Renji, but Renji manages to catch Yumichika, who is still alive. Renji uses his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#bankai|bankai]]'' to battle Gesell, and Ugaki loses control of his doll. Ugaki asks Kariya to save him, but Kariya refuses, watching as Gesell causes the cave to collapse upon Ugaki. Ichigo manages to escape from the debris and finds Kariya and the other Bounts. Ichigo begins to battle Kariya, who deals with Ichigo effortlessly. Kariya informs Ichigo that they never intended to connect the human world to the "world of the dead", but rather to the Soul Society in order to destroy the Soul Reapers, who created the Bounts.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 4
| EpisodeNumber   = 91
| EpisodeNumber2  = 28
| Title           = Shinigami and Quincy, the Reviving Power
| TranslitTitle   = Shinigami to Kuinshī, Yomigaeru Chikara
| NativeTitle     = 死神とクインシー、よみがえる力
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Manabu Fukazawa
| DirectedBy      = Shigeru Ueda
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|8|1}}
| AltDate         = December 7, 2008
| ShortSummary    = As Kariya is about to stab Ichigo with his own ''zanpakutō'', Ichigo grabs it and stabs himself with it, forcing his subconscious into the world of his ''zanpakutō'', [[List of Bleach characters#Zangetsu|Zangetsu]]. After a discussion with Zangetsu, Ichigo returns to reality and uses his ''bankai'', which enables him to fight evenly with Kariya. Uryū arrives and uses his powers to open the gateway created by the Bounts into the Soul Society. When Kariya thanks him, Uryū informs Kariya that he did so to defeat the Bounts in the Soul Society.
| LineColor       = ED872D
}}
